ExecutiveSummary: AI Health Connect is a Progressive Web App (PWA) designed to revolutionize patient-doctor interactions through AI-driven onboarding, consultations, and data management. The platform aims to enhance communication, streamline data handling, and provide valuable insights using advanced AI technologies. Accessible on mobile devices and desktops, the app ensures secure, user-friendly, and efficient healthcare delivery.
Background: The healthcare sector faces challenges in patient-doctor communication, data management, and accessibility. Traditional methods often lead to inefficiencies and gaps in patient care. AI Health Connect addresses these issues by leveraging AI for dynamic interactions, secure data storage, and real-time analysis, thereby improving healthcare outcomes and user experience.
Objectives: Enhance patient-doctor communication through AI-driven interactions.
Streamline data management with secure storage and easy access.
Provide AI-driven insights for better healthcare decision-making.
Ensure compliance with data security and privacy laws.
Deliver a user-friendly interface accessible on multiple devices.
Scope: The project scope includes developing a PWA for patients and doctors, focusing on user authentication, patient-doctor interactions, AI integration, and data management. The software will be accessible on mobile devices and desktops, ensuring broad accessibility and ease of use. Key features include user authentication, AI-guided onboarding, chat interface, historical data access, QR code integration, and secure data handling.
Deliverables: Functional PWA for patients and doctors.
Secure user authentication and data management.
AI integration for dynamic onboarding, conversation analysis, and report generation.
Compliance with data security and privacy laws.
Hosting on AWS with MongoDB for database storage.

KeyDeliverables: Patient and doctor registration with email and phone OTP verification
Login functionality for patients and doctors
Profile management for patients and doctors
Secure data encryption for user authentication
Dynamic questioning based on conversation context
Generation and viewing of patient summaries
Chat interface for text and voice interaction with AI
AI access to entire conversation history
Encryption of data in transit and at rest
Role-based access control for data protection
Compliance with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25

MitigationStrategies: Implement robust encryption for data in transit and at rest using industry-standard protocols like HTTPS and AES-256.
Conduct regular security audits and penetration testing to identify and address vulnerabilities.
Ensure compliance with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 by implementing strict access control mechanisms and maintaining detailed access logs.
Optimize AI models and API calls to ensure real-time or near-real-time responses.
Implement caching mechanisms to reduce redundant API calls and improve response times.
Monitor AI performance and usage to identify and address any latency or rate limit issues promptly.
Design the PWA with responsive design principles to ensure seamless functionality across various devices, including smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
Conduct extensive usability testing on different platforms (Android, iOS, web browsers) to identify and fix compatibility issues.
Follow platform-specific guidelines for both Android and iOS to ensure a consistent and intuitive user experience.

Details.Description: Develop an AI agent to interact with patients during the onboarding process. The AI will dynamically ask questions based on the conversation context and store all responses in a structured format.

Implement a chat interface that allows patients to interact with an AI agent via text or voice. The AI will have access to the entire conversation history to provide informed responses and analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being.

Provide AI assistance for doctors during consultations to analyze and summarize conversations in real-time. The AI will help retrieve relevant patient history and generate structured consultation reports.

Integrate transformer models for handling patient onboarding, summarizing conversation histories, and generating consultation reports. Ensure the models are trained and optimized for these specific tasks.
Utilize OpenAI's API for voice-to-text, text-to-voice, and text generation functionalities. This will enable the AI to effectively interact with users and provide accurate responses.
Implement logic for the AI to summarize long conversations and analyze them for key insights. This includes emotional and physical well-being, medical history, and other relevant factors.

Allow doctors to prompt the AI agent associated with a patient to retrieve specific information or insights from the patient's conversation history. This will aid doctors in making informed decisions during consultations.
Enable doctors to register and log in with OTP mobile verification and email verification. Allow doctors to manage their profile information, including name, phone number, email, and profile picture.
Provide doctors with a list of patients who have granted access via QR code. Allow doctors to access detailed profiles, including visit and consultation histories, of each patient.

Enable doctors to start a new consultation session by scanning the patient's QR code to link the consultation to the patient. Provide AI assistance during consultations for real-time analysis and summarization. Allow doctors to generate, review, edit, and approve consultation reports, and share approved reports with patients.

Allow doctors to prompt the AI agent associated with a patient to retrieve specific information or insights from the patient's conversation history. Use the AI to retrieve and summarize relevant patient history to aid the doctor during consultations.
Provide a feature for doctors to view a list of patients categorized by flags based on the patients' onboarding responses. This helps doctors prioritize and manage patient care effectively.
Send email notifications to doctors for important actions such as registration, verification, and report approvals. Ensure timely communication of critical updates and actions.
Implement robust access control mechanisms to protect patient data. Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest to comply with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 laws.

Enable patients to securely register, log in, and manage their profile information. This includes email and phone OTP verification during registration and the ability to update profile details such as name, phone number, email, and profile picture.

Provide an AI-guided onboarding process where patients can start a new visit, answer dynamic questions based on conversation context, and have their responses stored in a structured format. This process will generate a patient summary that can be viewed by both the patient and the doctor.

Implement a chat interface on the patient dashboard that allows patients to interact with an AI agent via text or voice. The AI will have access to the entire conversation history to provide informed responses, analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being, and summarize long conversations.

Allow patients to view their past onboarding summaries and consultation histories. This includes providing a tab for onboarding history and another for consultation history, where patients can access detailed reports of their interactions and consultations.

Details.Item: Profile Management and QR Code Access
Details.Description: Enable patients to manage their profile information and generate a QR code that doctors can scan to access the patient's visit and consultation histories. This feature will be available on the patient's profile page.

Send email notifications to patients for important actions such as registration, verification, and report approvals. This ensures that patients are kept informed about their account activities and medical updates.
